title: Independent conformer thermochemistry investigation of a chloride complex
difficulty_reasons: The agent must independently choose model chemistry and may generate and discriminate additional conformers.
Search coverage, endpoint validation, sensitivity and stopping must be justified without the paper route.

data.description: Two explicit XYZ inputs: E-AB-mTTA-(1,3)Ph chloride complex close and open; each has 101 atoms and metadata declaring charge -1 and multiplicity 1.

required_deliverables.description: Candidate identities, validated energies, signed relative free energy, search coverage, sensitivity, conclusion and limitations.
